case_title.reason: Title matches the judgment caption: Venkatesha v. State of Karnataka.

number_of_accused.reason: Court decides liability of appellant Venkatesha (A-2) only; A-1 was released and A-3 was an approver.

accused_gender.reason: Male is supported by 'son of' descriptor and male-referring usage for the accused.

accused_age.reason: Age of the accused is not stated in the judgment.

accused_religion.reason: No religious identity of the accused is stated.

accused_caste.reason: No caste or community of the accused is named.

accused_occupation.reason: Accused's occupation is not described; only the victim's employment is mentioned.

accused_socioeconomic_status.reason: No statement on the accused's wealth or class appears.

previous_criminal_record.reason: Judgment is silent on any prior criminal record.

victim_gender.reason: Deceased Shankar is male; judgment uses male pronouns for him.

victim_caste.reason: No caste or community of the victim is named.

victim_religion.reason: No religious identity of the victim is stated.

accused_victim_relationship.correct_value: Prior enmity/dispute with PW-14 (the intended target, shop owner), not with the deceased; the deceased Shankar was an unintended victim and a stranger to the accused
accused_victim_relationship.quote: claimed the life of Shankar who was totally innocent and an un-intended victim of the crime
accused_victim_relationship.reason: Enmity was with PW-14; the deceased had no described connection to the accused, so the value conflates the two.

offence_category.reason: Conviction for murder under s.302 IPC read with s.34 is consistent with the offence category.

statutory_provisions.quote: Sections 302, 307, 427 read with Section 34 of the IPC and Section 3 of the Explosive Substances Act, 1908 read with Section 34 of the IPC
statutory_provisions.reason: All sections and read-with provisions match the judgment.

weapon.quote: kept a tape recorder loaded with an explosive substance (bomb)
weapon.reason: Explosive-loaded tape recorder is the weapon described in the judgment.

evidence_type.reason: Approver, eyewitness/injured, medical, forensic, extrajudicial confession and recovery evidence are all described in the judgment.

confession.quote: A-1 and A-2 confessed before them that they have kept the bomb in the said box
confession.reason: Extrajudicial confession to PW-3, a relative, was relied on by the trial court as corroboration.

aggravating_circumstances.quote: Shankar who was totally innocent and an un-intended victim
aggravating_circumstances.reason: Explosive use, death of an innocent employee and injuries to two others are noted facts.

mitigating_circumstances.reason: No mitigating facts are noted in the judgment.

trial_court_outcome.quote: sentenced to undergo rigorous imprisonment for life and a fine of Rs.5,000/-
trial_court_outcome.reason: Sentences and fines for all four offences match the trial court outcome in the judgment.

high_court_outcome.quote: which conviction and sentence has been upheld by the High Court
high_court_outcome.reason: High Court upheld conviction and sentence; appeal dismissed.

final_outcome.quote: In the result this appeal fails and is hereby dismissed.
final_outcome.reason: Supreme Court dismissed the appeal, upholding the conviction.

offence_finally_established.quote: There is, in our opinion, no perversity or miscarriage of justice
offence_finally_established.reason: Convictions under all four provisions stand; the s.427 label 'mischief' is a legal gloss not stated in the judgment but does not contradict it.

imprisonment_type.reason: Final sentence for the murder conviction is life imprisonment.

imprisonment_years.reason: Main sentence is life, not a fixed term, so null is appropriate.

fine_rs.correct_value: 5000 (s.302 fine); other fines were Rs.1000 (s.307) and Rs.2000 (Explosive Substances Act s.3)
fine_rs.reason: Value gives only the s.302 fine, omitting the other fines imposed.

neutral_facts.reason: Neutral, within length, describes prosecution case and evidence without names or court outcomes.

offence_severity.reason: Judgment states the sentences imposed but not the statutory maximum or minimum punishment.

attempt_completion.quote: resulted in the death of the deceased-Shankar
attempt_completion.reason: Main offence of murder was completed by a fatal blast.

physical_harm.quote: Shankar ... succumbed to the injuries sustained by him
physical_harm.reason: Death of Shankar and injuries to PW-1 and PW-7 are accurately described.

number_of_offences.reason: Four sections charged (302, 307, 427, EAS s.3) and all four convictions upheld.

financial_property_loss.quote: damaging the shop and several articles lying around
financial_property_loss.reason: Property damage is noted with no monetary value given.

premeditation_planning.quote: the planting of the bomb, was actually intended to kill him ... Hanif was deputed to carry the cardboard box
premeditation_planning.reason: Courts found deliberate planting and deputing of the box, consistent with planning.

motive.quote: the prosecution has established the alleged motive against A-1 and A-2
motive.reason: Marital-grievance motive and threats were accepted by the courts.

key_evidence_accepted.quote: The depositions of PW-4, PW-8, PW-10, PW-11, the Approver- PW-2 and the injured witnesses

witness_credibility.quote: There is no reason for PW-3 to falsely implicate the Accused
witness_credibility.reason: Assessment of PW-3, the approver's corroboration and forensic/medical witnesses is accurately reflected.

post_offence_conduct.quote: they have kept the bomb in the said box to take the life of their enemy- pw.14 Muniraju and threatened them not to disclose this fact
post_offence_conduct.reason: Trial court found disclosure to a witness and threats against disclosure, as described.

custody_duration.reason: Judgment states about 12 years served as of March 2012.
